Hi Aditya,

Tidemark is planning a small CFO roundtable for about 14 guests in late March and we loved your note about a chef's-counter format. Can you confirm whether Redwood can host this in a chef-counter set-up (close seating, tasting menu) and how you handle guest NDAs/confidentiality? Desired outcome: private conversation with 4 short lightning talks + seated pairing.

Happy to share a short list of attendees once you confirm venue approach and any contracting that will be needed on our side.

Looping you both in — Elaine at Tidemark wants a chef's-counter style CFO roundtable (14 ppl) March 24 or 25. They prefer a short privacy addendum instead of full NDAs. Can Marissa check venue leads that can do an enclosed chef's-counter/private room and share quick cost + draft contract? From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Cc: connor_obrien@redwood.ai, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 16 Jan 2026 09:18:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fw: Quick ask — vendor + privacy for CFO dinner

Thanks Aditya — looked into three spots. The Ember Room (SoMa) can do a chef's-counter for up to 16, fully private with a small deposit and a venue fee of $2,500 + food per head. They provided a draft contract (attached) and a standard vendor privacy addendum they attach to hospitality events. Bite & Co (preferred caterer) can do a tasting menu at $95/person with plated vs family-style options and can handle dietary restrictions.

Quick summary:
- The Ember Room: available March 24, holds 12–16 at counter, contract attached (TheEmberRoom_contract_draft.pdf). They require signed contract + 50% deposit.
- Alternate: The Garden Table (semi-private) — cheaper but not chef-counter.

Next steps I recommend:
1) Send the Ember Room contract to legal with their privacy addendum redlined.
2) Confirm guest dietary constraints and finalize menu option.
3) Decide sponsorship split (we cover venue fee, Tidemark covers food) — I put estimated numbers in the contract margins.

Attaching menu options from Bite & Co (menu_options_biteandco.pdf).

Marissa Cole
Events Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
[Attachment: TheEmberRoom_contract_draft.pdf, menu_options_biteandco.pdf]

From: connor_obrien@redwood.ai
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Cc: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 19 Jan 2026 08:51:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fw: Quick ask — vendor + privacy for CFO dinner

Marissa — thanks for the options. I reviewed the Ember Room draft and their "privacy addendum" is basically a one-paragraph confidentiality clause for guest conversations and no recording. That aligns with what we normally approve for customer dinners, but legal wants a small tweak: add a clause that specifies Redwood is not collecting or retaining attendee content and that any sponsor materials distributed are on a handout basis only. I'll prepare a 2-line redline and request legal to sign off.

Also: procurement needs a P.O. for venue deposit and the Ember Room requires vendor insurance on file. Can you start the vendor packet? I can expedite the PO once we have the final contract.

I'll draft the redline and paste it below so we can send to Elaine and Ember Room.

-- quoted redline start --
Add to privacy addendum: "Host (Redwood Inference) will not record or retain private attendee discussions and will only share sponsor-provided printed materials with attendees; no audio/video capture without explicit written consent from all attendees."
-- quoted redline end --

Connor O'Brien
Partnerships Ops, Redwood Inference
connor_obrien@redwood.ai

Hi Elaine — thanks for the quick turnaround.

We confirmed The Ember Room can host on March 24 (chef's-counter, up to 16). We've added a short privacy addendum (one paragraph + the 2-line host clause our legal requested) and attached the venue contract. For transparency, Redwood proposes covering the venue fee; Tidemark would cover food and beverage costs. If that works, we'll send the contract to The Ember Room for signature and push a DocuSign envelope to you for the privacy addendum and the final guest list.

I've included a DocuSign link for the addendum and venue charge: https://www.docusign.net/Env/EnvelopeId=1234-EMB-TIDE-2026

Final asks from our side to get this locked:
- Tidemark approval of sponsorship split (venue vs food).
- Any dietary constraints for the guest list (attached updated guest_list_initial.xlsx).
- Quick confirmation you approve the privacy addendum wording (pasted below).

Privacy addendum (for your review):
"Attendees agree to keep private any non-public commercial information shared during the event. Host (Redwood Inference) will not record or retain private attendee discussions and will only share sponsor-provided printed materials with attendees; no audio/video capture without explicit written consent from all attendees."

If you approve, I will route the contract and addendum for signatures and confirm deposit timeline with Ember Room.
